flagship_project.name: Project NanoTrader-X: Sub-Microsecond FPGA/Kernel-Bypass Algorithmic Risk Gate & Multi-Exchange Sovereign Matching Fabric
flagship_project.pillar: Kernel-Bypass Low-Latency Financial Exchange Infrastructure & Pre-Trade Risk Engine
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Zerodha executes 15M+ daily retail trades on NSE and BSE. NanoTrader-X deploys FPGA-accelerated pre-trade risk checks, kernel-bypass Solarflare OpenOnload network stacks, and zero-allocation C/Rust order routers to guarantee deterministic sub-microsecond risk evaluation during market open panic bursts.
flagship_project.tech_stack: C++20 / Rust (Zero-Allocation Risk Engine), FPGA (Verilog Pre-Trade Filter), Solarflare EF_VI / Solarflare OpenOnload, Redis / DragonflyDB, ClickHouse (Tick Telemetry Archive), Go (Public Kite Connect API)
flagship_project.kpis: Pre-trade risk check latency reduced from 85 microseconds to 850 nanoseconds; zero server dropouts during 9:15 AM market opening surges; zero rupee external funding dependency maintained.
